name: Shattered Glass Case
description: The display case is broken, with glass shards scattered around.
inspectText: The glass is thick, but shattered cleanly. A small cloth fragment is caught on a shard.

name: Muddy Footprint
description: A clear footprint leading away from the case, size 10.
inspectText: The footprint is deep, suggesting a heavy person. It is made of reddish clay.

name: Wet Umbrella
description: A black umbrella, still wet, leaning against the desk.
inspectText: The umbrella is wet, but the floor around it is dry. It must have been brought inside recently.

name: Note
description: A handwritten note on Dr. Vega's desk.
inspectText: The note reads: 'Meet me at midnight. Bring the key.' It is signed with a 'V'.

name: Map with Marks
description: A map of the observatory with a route marked in red from the main hall to the roof.
inspectText: The red line goes through the library and ends at the rooftop. There is a small smudge of red clay near the roof exit.

name: Pair of Gloves
description: A pair of leather gloves, found under a chair.
inspectText: The gloves are worn, but the right glove has a small tear on the index finger. There is a faint smell of metal polish.

name: Crowbar
description: A crowbar hidden behind a vent on the roof.
inspectText: The crowbar is clean, but the tip matches the pry marks on the display case. A hair is caught in the hinge.

name: Gem Fragment
description: A small fragment of the Starfire Diamond, caught in a crevice.
inspectText: The fragment is a deep blue. It must have broken off during the theft.
